'''Rewards'''
---- {{Removed|date = 16th of December 2024}}
'''Rewards''' follow some achievements that you could get. These rewards could be small, like extra {{Exp|}}, or large, like a free crate or even a tower. It could be opened while you were in the lobby.
{{ScrollTOC|350px|float = right}} ==Achievements== Achievements were goals which, when reached, reward the player with a [[Titles|Title]] and different rewards, generally {{Coins|Coins}}. They could also give out some less common rewards, like [[High Grade Crate]] or [[Molten Monster (Consumable)|Molten Monster]] consumables. The objectives for the achievements vary. Some of them could be just counters, such as [[Logbooks]] obtained, or objectives that required to be beaten once, such as triumphing [[Pizza Party]] in a Solo. For rewards, the [[Titles]] are not be listed, as every single achievement gives one. The only exception is achievements where the name of a [[Titles|Title]] is different from the achievement name. Some [[badges]] give you additional rewards once you earn them. You can redeem the rewards here. You can only redeem the rewards once. While these rewards were linked to your [[badges]], it was a completely independent system. Therefore, deleting your [[badges]] and re-earning them would not give you any additional rewards. '' |{{Exp|150}} |} ===Season=== [[File:KRBattlepass.png|center|700px]] Under the ''Season'' section, you could see various information about the ongoing pass. This included how many Season [[Currencies|currency]] you had, how many ranks you had completed, rewards for ranks and when the pass started and ended. To claim a reward, you needed to pick a completed rank and click the ''Claim Reward'' button. This section has been removed as of the [[v1.37.0|Hexscape Update]]. A full list of passes can be found [[Passes|here]]. ===Scores=== [[File:Scores.png|center|700px]] Under the ''Scores'' section, the maps you had triumphed on were shown. For the maps you had triumphed on, you were able to set your [[Profile Cards|Profile Card]] background to that map. You got no additional rewards in this section. This section has been removed as of the [[v1.37.0|Hexscape Update]]. Note that this section only showed maps triumphed after the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]]. Prior to the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], this section was called ''Normal'' and you could redeem the [[Platinum Crate]] through here. All ''Scores'' were wiped after the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]]. Sometime in 2023-2024 The original polluted wastelands was removed from the scores tab, this made the profile card of the players displaying it blank, if they were not changed before scores were removed it will be blank forever. ====Survival==== This is where all maps triumphed under regular gameplay conditions were shown. The [[Gamemodes|gamemode]] in which you triumphed the specific map was highlighted. Pressing a highlighted badge would change the timer from the currently shown time to the fastest time you got on that gamemode. ====Hardcore==== This is where all the maps triumphed in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode were shown. Note that it did not show any medal, just a tick. It was impossible to see the recorded time as you did not get a badge that could show it. ====Solo==== This is where all maps triumphed with no other people were shown. This section never worked. ====Event==== This is where all maps triumphed during an event were shown, however the only event map that could be recorded was the [[Trick or Threat Town]]. Any other event map you completed would not appear here. Note that it did not show any medal, just a tick. It was impossible to see the recorded time as you did not get a badge that could show it. ===Event=== {| class="empty-table" style="width:800px; text-align:center; margin:0 auto" |[[File:EventStore0.png|center|300px]] |[[File:EventStore1.png|center|300px]] |} This section only existed during the [[Christmas 2019 Event]] and [[Spring 2020 Event]].
